title: [Security] Incomplete Fix for CVE-2026-44513: community Pipeline Branch Bypasses trust_remote_code Check
author: icysun

comments.author: hlky
comments.body: @icysun This behavior was chosen after review. It will only load from `diffusers/community-pipelines-mirror` which is a mirror of [code already in diffusers repo](https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers/tree/main/examples/community). This also prevents name squatting attacks of Hub repos with similar names to community pipelines; if you see a code sample with `custom_pipeline=...` that is supposed to be a verified community pipeline then you can be sure it won't execute remote code as any truly remote code via `custom_pipeline` would require `trust_remote_code=True`.

comments.author: DN6
comments.body: Closing since this has been discussed in https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers/pull/13448/changes#r3113668418 and is expected behaviour.  Pipelines in `diffusers/community-pipelines-mirror` are trusted.
